summary: The database sample also measures the WAL and physical daily growth, for every reader of the store's size

schema.detail: No tables or indexes. database_size_samples rows in meta gain the WAL's and the main file's lengths; three-element rows from the previous build still read and are never a physical baseline.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The request-latency database row adds wal_bytes, main_file_bytes, physical_bytes (the two file lengths), physical_growth_bytes_per_day and physical_growth_span_ms. st3::slo::database_size exposes the cached newest sample so other readers use one sampler.

downtime.detail: None. One more file length per hourly sample.

manual.detail: No manual step. Physical growth appears once a sample within half an hour of a day ago exists.

recovery.detail: The previous build ignores the fourth element.
